verdict.rationale: Channel3 does not document a general automation builder. Its own price-tracking subscriptions do run in the background: a user subscribes to a product once, and Channel3 monitors it on an ongoing basis and fires webhook notifications when the price changes. Agentic search is a one-off, per-request LLM planning mode, and the CLI and SDK only make scripted calls, so neither counts as background automation. Missing for 10: user-defined or configurable automations beyond price tracking, documented scheduling or recurrence controls, management of running automations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that price-tracking subscriptions work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When you subscribe to price tracking for a product, you can receive webhook notifications whenever the price changes.
